overview: This item focuses on systematically reviewing the current ash_jido implementation to understand how Ash resources, actions, and data layers are being exposed into Jido's agent model. The review should cover module structure, configuration conventions, mapping between Ash resources/actions and Jido actions/tools, error handling patterns, and how contexts (tenant, actor, authorization) flow through. The goal is to produce a clear picture of what works today, what is experimental or ad hoc, and where the integration relies on implicit assumptions. As a deliverable, capture a short written assessment that highlights strengths, gaps, and technical debt, plus a list of concrete follow-up tasks for stabilization. This should include notes on test coverage, edge cases, compatibility with current Ash versions, and how easy it is for a typical Ash project to adopt ash_jido.
title: Review current implementation
